description: GNSS - Færøerne is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Klimadatastyrelsen. The GNSS Faroe Islands contain files from Faroese GNSS stations. Data can be used to post-process own data in relation to GNSS stations in the Faroe Islands. Data can also be used to calculate other surveying and research-related tasks. Coverage: Klimadatastyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "GNSS - Faroe Islands" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Klimadatastyrelsen. The listing shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
